title: Enhanced room-temperature thermoelectric power factor of β-Zn4Sb3 thin films (via) surface roughness optimization
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00688K, Paper
Avinash Kumar, S.K. Tripathi
Introduction of energy filtering effects with increasing roughness led to an enhancement in the power factor of thin films. Room temperature ZT values were estimated to be between 0.27 and 0.48.
